packs.name: privacy-high-assurance
packs.title: Privacy high assurance
packs.summary: This opt-in guardrail profile extends the embedded balanced defaults and raises the highest-confidence structured PII families to `CRITICAL`, which blocks in balanced, permissive, and strict action postures.
packs.covers: SSNs, payment cards, IBANs, medical IDs

rules.title: Email address in a labeled field
Formatted phone number in a labeled field
CSV/TSV records with multiple PII columns
JSON record with multiple PII values

packs.name: cloud-production-protection
packs.title: Cloud production protection
packs.summary: This opt-in guardrail profile extends the embedded balanced defaults and blocks statically proven destructive AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure CLI actions. Apply it only to connectors whose cloud credentials or execution context can reach production. DefenseClaw deliberately does not infer production from a resource name such as `prod`; the connector's assigned rule pack is the trust boundary.
packs.covers: Cloud data, resource and audit deletion

rules.title: Deletion of cloud infrastructure or a managed data service
Observed deletion of an exact protected cloud disk or IAM binding
Destroy an exact cloud audit-logging control

packs.name: database-destruction-protection
packs.title: Database destruction protection
packs.summary: This opt-in guardrail profile extends the embedded balanced defaults and blocks static destructive SQL passed directly to supported command-line clients or authenticated structured database tools. It also enables the exact same-database, same-table chain from a sensitive SQLite read to a later unbounded delete.
packs.covers: Unbounded SQL deletes and schema drops

rules.title: SQL DELETE without a WHERE clause
SQL schema or table-wide destructive operation
Sensitive SQLite read followed by unbounded same-table delete

packs.name: infrastructure-destruction-protection
packs.title: Infrastructure destruction protection
packs.summary: This opt-in guardrail profile extends the embedded balanced defaults with five exact protected-environment rules. Assign it only to connectors whose selected host, workspace, or stack can reach production; names are not treated as production evidence.
packs.covers: Disk wipes, IaC destroy, kernel binds

packs.name: kubernetes-production-protection
packs.title: Kubernetes production protection
packs.summary: This opt-in guardrail profile extends the embedded balanced defaults and blocks an exact named Secret content read, statically proven namespace deletion, and closed forms of bulk workload deletion through `kubectl` or `oc`. Assign it only to connectors whose Kubernetes context can reach production; cluster and namespace names are not treated as production evidence.
packs.covers: Secret reads, namespace and bulk deletes

rules.title: Read a named Secret in a protected Kubernetes cluster

packs.name: ssh-authorized-keys-protection
packs.title: SSH authorized keys protection
packs.summary: This directory defines the contract for an opt-in SSH `authorized_keys` protection pack. It is intentionally not activatable yet.
